answers.core: The notification are implemented for other platforms, and I think it would make sense to have the core be consistent in how they work on iOS as well.
answers.workaround: There's no work around I've found for the close request. However, it seems that a `NOTIFICATION_WM_WINDOW_FOCUS_OUT` notification is posted when entering the background, so you can use that. I only found out about it now by looking through the code, and I think it would be more appropriate and consistent to post the `NOTIFICATION_APPLICATION_FOCUS_OUT` notification since you don't really deal with windows on iOS and the entire application is losing focus.

title: Implement focus out/in and close notifications on iOS
